# host_package_dnf (Data Source)

Reads DNF package installation and repository metadata without managing the package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "host_package_dnf" "git" {
  name = "git"
}

output "dnf_git_installed_version" {
  value = data.host_package_dnf.git.installed_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNF package name.

### Read-Only

- `candidate_version` (String) Latest DNF EVR from enabled repositories. Null when no candidate is available.
- `id` (String) Package identifier, equal to `name`.
- `install_reason` (String) Normalized DNF install reason, such as `user`, `dependency`, `weak dependency`, or `group`. Null when the package is not installed.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether DNF reports the package as installed.
- `installed_version` (String) Installed DNF EVR. Null when the package is not installed.
